sections.title: A family pit, *going since 1968*
body: Willie Mae Baltzegar opened Carolina Bar-B-Que in 1968. She learned from her father, Rowesville pitmaster Willie Baltzegar, which is why folks who know South Carolina barbecue find a family resemblance in the pork, the hash and the sauce.
Today Jess "Bubba" Walker keeps the pit going. We still cook shoulders only, still serve it buffet-style, and still leave the sauce to you.
